title: themeda ciliata
intro: Themeda ciliata, commonly known as the Blue Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Themeda ciliata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antipyretic, analgesic, and expectorant effects.
